-- T3c's control: a handle used inside the generation that minted it.
module Test.ElabScope.Accepted (accepted) where

import Prelude
import Data.Either (Either)
import Domain.Elaborating (Elaborating)
import Domain.Type (Ty)
import Domain.Checked.Internal (Open)
import Features.Check.Generate.Elab (readType, seal)
import Features.Check.Generate.Fault (GenerationFault)
import Features.Check.Generate.Gen (fresh)
import Test.ElabScope.Common (header, minted, site)

accepted ∷ Either GenerationFault (Elaborating (Ty Open))
accepted = seal header (readType site <$> fresh minted)
